decisions.reason: As a product with its own page in both 2023 and 2024, it reflects an early and visible commitment that management is likely to defend and continue rather than reverse quickly.
Its move from a simple mention in 2023 to a dedicated page in 2024 signals additional investment and public backing, which under escalation of commitment makes withdrawal unlikely in 2025.
The stronger 2024 website presence suggests the firm has doubled down on this software line and will likely attribute any shortfalls to temporary market-development issues rather than drop it soon.
Because the firm elevated it to a standalone offering in 2024 after launch, management is likely to persist with it to justify the resources and credibility already committed.
